description: This PHP source file defines the UpdatePasswordAPI class, which provides an API endpoint for updating a user's password in the OrangeHRM system. It includes validation rules, documentation annotations, and methods for handling the password update process.

classes.name: UpdatePasswordAPI
classes.description: API endpoint class for handling user password update requests. Extends Endpoint and implements ResourceEndpoint, utilizing traits for user role management, user services, and date-time helpers. Defines validation rules and handles the password update logic.

methods.name: getOne
methods.description: Throws a not implemented exception as this endpoint does not support GET requests.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetOne
methods.description: Returns a not implemented exception, indicating no validation rules for GET method.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Handles the PUT request to update the user's password. Retrieves the current user, updates the password, sets the modification date, saves the user, and returns the updated user model.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForUpdate
methods.description: Provides validation rules for the update method, including checks for current password correctness and new password complexity and length.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Throws a not implemented exception, as delete operation is not supported for this endpoint.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForDelete
methods.description: Returns a not implemented exception, indicating no delete validation rules.
